LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingRemoveAll: Remove every treatment condition from every pawn
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_SettingRemoveAllDesc: Do this, and deconstruct the machines and burn unit beds, before you take this mod out of a colony. Then save and switch the mod off.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_RemoveNeedsGame: Load a colony first: there are no pawns to change in the main menu.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_RemoveDone: Removed {COUNT} treatment conditions. Save the game before you switch the mod off.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusSwitchedOff: Switched off, so nobody gets oxygen from it.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusNoBed: Not against a bed it can serve. Build it touching a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusNoOxygen: Out of oxygen: waiting for canisters or a connected oxygen pipe.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusWaiting: Waiting for a patient who needs oxygen.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_StatusNotNeeded: Breathing well enough without it: {PATIENTS}. Oxygen starts if breathing weakens, or after smoke or fumes.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedSwitchedOff: Blower switched off, so nobody gets air-cell care. It still works as a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedNoPower: Waiting for power for its blower. It still works as a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedWaiting: Waiting for a patient with open burns.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_BurnBedNotNeeded: No open burns on {PATIENTS}, so no air-cell care. It still works as a hospital bed.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_TipOnOxygenPlain: Clears carbon monoxide about four times faster, and eases low breathing.
LanguageData.PhobosMedical_TipOnOxygen: Carbon monoxide half-life on oxygen: {MINUTES} minutes, against about 320 on room air. Eases low breathing, up to normal.
